text_block_list.text:
On the way back from
an outing with Mihono Bourbon—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Master.
What constitutes a "precious memory"
between you and me?
choice_data_list: What's with you all of a sudden?
What's gotten into you all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...The truth is.
According to Mihono Bourbon, that topic apparently came up in her class.

After getting their Trainers,
everyone made their own precious memories.
Amidst all that, Mihono Bourbon—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: What does... "precious" mean?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I understand the meaning of those words.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"‘Precious’ means something of great value.
Something you wish never to break."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: However, how does that connect to memories? Memories are thoughts to begin with, aren't they unbreakable?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
What qualifies as a "precious memory"...?
I cannot make that determination myself.
choice_data_list: Can't think of anything off the top of your head?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: All at once... is it?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
To detect it from data logs,
I determine that understanding 'preciousness'
is required.

Mihono Bourbon probably doesn't fully understand the concept of something being 'precious.'
In that case, until she figures it out—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...In order to understand what makes something 'precious',
are we to create even more 'memories'?"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
choice_data_list: Let's start making memories right away!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Understood. Now then—

—The next day, I visited the park
in the evening together with Mihono Bourbon.
choice_data_list: Is there something you want to do at the park?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: When asked about their "Precious Memories with Trainer," the most common response was "Being there to listen to my worries."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Based on information from classmates,
it was determined that conditions exceeding "dusk," "park," and "just the two of us"
were optimal for "discussing personal worries."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Therefore, I proceeded to put it into practice.
choice_data_list: If anything's bothering you, I'm always here to listen.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Status 'Perplexity' detected.
This is troubling; I have no particular worries.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Failure. Moving on to the next.
choice_data_list: Want to try playing normally for once?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Playing in the park—
In other words, we shall be playing tag, correct?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Well then,
who should start off as "it"?
For some reason, I ended up playing tag with Mihono Bourbon.
"Naturally, if Mihono Bourbon were 'it,' we'd be caught in an instant; conversely, if we were 'it,' we could never catch her—"

It was a game of tag with an all-too-predictable outcome.
It's hardly going to become a "precious memory."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...It's a failure.
choice_data_list: Let me rest for a bit...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Irregular breathing detected from Master.
I assess that immediate rest is required.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I think we should save making memories for next time.

...To be honest, I was completely useless this time.
Maybe next time I should be the one
to propose something.
choice_data_list: I'll try even harder next time!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Give it my all...?
Is that not something I ought to be doing anyway?
choice_data_list: After all, it's a memory you two will create together.
Because it's a memory the two of you will make together.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Understood.
Thank you for your cooperation, Master.

After staring intently at my face and saying
her thanks, Mihono Bourbon made a promise to make
our next "precious memory" together.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I will follow your orders, Master.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Decline in Master's stamina confirmed.
Assessing locomotion to be difficult.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I'll carry it over to the bench.

Taking a seat on the bench and letting out a deep sigh,
I noticed Mihono Bourbon looking as though
she had something to say.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Master.
The objective was not achieved this time.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, Master is utterly exhausted.
In other words, today's events
were, for Master...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: "...Did that end up becoming an 'unpleasant memory' for you?"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Really?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
choice_data_list: In its own way, this is a fond memory too.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Is that... so.
...Thank you very much, Master.

After receiving their thanks, I smiled back,
ready to make more 'precious memories' together.

After looking down for a moment as if in thought,
Mihono Bourbon gave a small nod.
